display_name: Bảo Minh construction all risks insurance rules: period of insurance, General Exclusions and Conditions, Section I material damage with Articles I-3, and Section II third-party liability

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by `tools/vnsrc.py quote` from line N of ../../source/raw/baominh-car.txt, and in short runs checked by `tools/vnsrc.py check` to occur verbatim in it.

source.authority: private contract terms published by the insurer, not law

scope: The whole document as published at its URL on 2026-10-06: the recital and insuring agreement, the General Exclusions (a)-(d) with the burden of proof, the period of insurance, General Conditions 1-9, Section I (insuring clause, debris, exclusions (a)-(i), Articles I, 2 and 3) and Section II (insuring clause, costs, limit, exclusions 1-4, Conditions 1-2). 63 coverage rows: 55 encoded, 6 inert, 2 reached-and-refused, 0 out-of-scope, 0 deferred. Every Schedule figure is an input. Declined by a named REFUSE: the burden of proof where Bao Minh contends General Exclusion (a); the General Condition 4(b) adjustment; General Condition 9's rateable proportion; the Article I measure for items other than 1-3 or where the value is not established; the time for payment. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: Recital: the truncated deeming of the proposal is read as incorporation; inert.
forks.F2: Insuring agreement: premium payment is a fact at the time the claim is decided; no time is stated.
forks.F3: General Exclusions: 'directly or indirectly' means any listed risk among the causes excludes.
forks.F4: Burden of proof: the clause as written (the Insured contends) is encoded; Bao Minh contending is refused.
forks.F5: Commencement: the earlier of the works commencing and the scheduled items being unloaded, for the whole policy.
forks.F6: The Schedule's start date does not govern; cover can begin before it.
forks.F7: A part leaves cover when handed over AND put into use.
forks.F8: The Schedule's end date is inside the period.
forks.F9: General Condition 1: any breach of any duty defeats liability; no materiality or causation test.
forks.F10: General Condition 4(b): telegram and writing both required; the adjustment of cover or premium is refused.
forks.F11: General Condition 5(a): 'immediately' is a fact to be found; (telephone or telegram) and writing.
forks.F12: General Condition 5: 14 calendar days, the day of the occurrence not counted, receipt on day 14 in time.
forks.F13: General Condition 5: minor damage and the reasonable inspection period are inputs.
forks.F14: General Condition 5, last paragraph: cover on an unrepaired item ends for later occurrences.
forks.F15: General Condition 7: only the amount is arbitrable; one calendar month from the day the request is sent.
forks.F16: General Condition 8: the time-bar runs three calendar months from an award (by any maker) on a rejected claim; none from a rejection alone.
forks.F17: General Condition 9: the rateable proportion is not defined; refused.
forks.F18: Section I: 'that limit of indemnity' is an optional Schedule per-occurrence limit.
forks.F19: Section I: the total sum insured less earlier payments caps each occurrence.
forks.F20: Debris clearance: only with a covered loss, up to the separate sum, not averaged, outside the deductible, inside the caps.
forks.F21: Section I deductible: once per occurrence, after the per-item average.
forks.F22: Exclusion (d): 'hạng mục' read as a component; the Schedule-item reading is finding X14.
forks.F23: Exclusion (e): the qualifier reaches all four kinds of deterioration.
forks.F24: Exclusion (f): the plant's own breakdown only.
forks.F25: Article I: the principal's materials are added to the contract value.
forks.F26: Article I: average per item on the Article 2 amount, before the item cap and the deductible; items other than 1-3 refused.
forks.F27: Article 2: 'only costs actually incurred' applies to repairable and total losses.
forks.F28: Article 2: repair cost at least equal to the value switches to the total-loss basis.
forks.F29: Section II: 'third party' undefined; anyone but the Insured, subject to exclusions 4(a)-(b).
forks.F30: Section II: the limit applies per occurrence, costs inside it, deductible on damages and costs together.
forks.F31: Section II: consented costs of a claim within cover are paid even if the Insured is held not liable.
forks.F32: Section II exclusion 3: the second limb reaches harm caused by the damaged property, not harm caused directly by vibration.
forks.F33: Section II Condition 2: the settlement sum is Bao Minh's figure, an input.
forks.F34: No time for payment is stated; refused.
forks.F35: Section II Condition 1 is not read for a Section I claim.
forks.F36: LAW: Art 24 (Law lines 588-591), contra proferentem; noted per fork, not applied.
forks.F37: LAW: Art 19.2 (Law lines 435-440), exclusions must be explained; not modelled.
forks.F38: LAW: Art 19.3 and Art 46 (Law lines 441-444, 917-932), late notice; not resolved.
forks.F39: LAW: Art 30 (Law lines 706-717), one year to submit claim documents; the document states none.
forks.F40: LAW: Art 31 (Law lines 718-729), 15 days to pay where none is agreed.
forks.F41: LAW: Art 32 (Law lines 730-734), dispute resolution; the document has a forum for the amount only.
forks.F42: LAW: Art 48 (Law lines 955-963), underinsurance at market value or as agreed.
forks.F43: LAW: Art 49 (Law lines 964-973), double insurance by sums insured.
forks.F44: LAW: Art 52 (Law lines 997-1010), form of indemnity.
forks.F45: LAW: Art 59 (Law lines 1090-1115), liability costs on top of the limit unless otherwise agreed.
forks.F46: LAW: Art 22.2 (Law lines 543-553), avoidance for intentional untruth only.
forks.F47: LAW: Art 8 (Law line 231), compulsory construction-investment insurance is a separate regime.
forks.F49: LAW: Arts 26-27 (Law lines 623-678), non-payment of premium.

self_check.quotation_check: python3 -I tools/vnsrc.py check ../../source/raw/baominh-car.txt over every .l4 and every .md except BRIEF.md

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run. Every expected value in bmcar-tests.l4 and bmcar-findings.l4 was written by the same session that wrote the rules, worked by hand from the text before it was asserted.
